summary_1line: Mandapala reconciles with Jarita and their sons after the Khandava fire; Indra rewards Arjuna and Krishna with boons as the forest’s destruction concludes.

image_candidates.scene_text: Jarita rushes to the charred clearing and embraces her four surviving chicks as smoke rises from the burned Khandava forest.
Indra descends from the sky surrounded by the Maruts, addressing Arjuna and Krishna after the blazing forest has been consumed.
Agni, radiant and satisfied after devouring the forest, appears before Arjuna and Krishna amid drifting smoke and ash.
